summary: 27-year-old Arvada man Josh Hall reported overdue in the evening after departing Hessie Trailhead with his dog Happy toward Devil's Thumb Lake; vehicle found at trailhead; cell ping near Devil's Thumb Trail/Diamond Lake cutoff; winter storm; multi-agency search Feb 3-8 (70+ rescuers, 650+ hours) suspended due to avalanche danger and weather; dog found alive Feb 11 on Peak to Peak Hwy near MM 40; partial remains found July 1, 2021 ~4.3 mi west of Hessie near the Diamond Lake Trail by a Front Range Rescue Dogs volunteer and confirmed as Hall
location: Hessie Trailhead / Devil's Thumb Lake area
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Alpine Rescue Team, Larimer County SAR, Diamond Peaks Ski Patrol, Front Range Rescue Dogs, Nederland Fire Protection District, Boulder Emergency Squad, Colorado SAR Association, Air Force Rescue Coordination Center, Flight for Life Colorado, City of Boulder Watershed
notes: BCSO search update Feb 8, 2021 (ground search suspended, aerial ongoing); Mountain-Ear timeline (Feb 18, 2021 edition); recovery of remains involved BCSO, RMRG, Front Range Rescue Dogs, Canon City Helitack | BCSO release case 21-659 appended (merged run 526) run 791 merge: Mountain-Ear mid-search update on the 2021-02-03 Josh Hall search (BCSO case #21-659; ~70 rescuers, 650+ person-hours, ground search suspended pending snow melt). 2026-09-20: merged GCSAR FB post permalink (GCSAR post noting it assisted the initial February 2021 search for Josh Hall (Hessie Trail).
